text: Assumption: The symbols are used in AUTOSAR modules as standardized return values or status values to indicate logical operating modes — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The symbols are used in AUTOSAR modules as standardized return values or status values to indicate logical operating modes — is this correct?
norm: the symbols are used in autosar modules as standardized return values or status values to indicate logical operating modes
assumption: The symbols are used in AUTOSAR modules as standardized return values or status values to indicate logical operating modes.
rationale: The payload merely specifies the definition and value assignment as logical states active/idle, but does not mention any concrete callers.

original.text: Annahme: Die Symbole dürften in AUTOSAR-Modulen als standardisierte Rückgabe- oder Statuswerte zur Kennzeichnung logischer Betriebsmodi verwendet werden — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: Der Payload spezifiziert lediglich die Definition und Wertebelegung als logische Zustände active/idle, nennt aber keine konkreten Aufrufer.
